description:
Space Saviors — São Paulo, Brazil

We are four 10-year-old fifth-graders from São Paulo, plus one parent keeping us on schedule. We build a playable 3D mission-design game: choose an orbit, assemble a spacecraft, check your mass and delta-v, and launch — if the math does not close, the mission does not fly. Our four missions follow real ones (ADRAS-J2, DART, Perseverance, Europa Clipper). We cover game design, coding, mission research and testing.
